messages:
DeployBot: :rotating_light: deploy-check FAILED for release v2.14.0 -> parity-check: SERVICE_CONFIG shape differs between staging and prod. Blocking promotion.
Ashley: ugh, saw the alert. can someone paste the diff? :eyes:
Samir: staging SERVICE_CONFIG = `{
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "ttl": 600 },
  "features": ["kv-prefix-opt"]
}`
Samir: prod SERVICE_CONFIG = `"{\"cache\":true}"` (stringified tiny blob)
Mira: wow, prod has an older deploy that stringifies the object. this will break the new runtime parsing of kvcache keys.
Devin: is this from the env-loader change we rolled in canary? the deploy note said "normalize SERVICE_CONFIG to json struct"
Ashley: yes, that was part of the config-normalization refactor in the last canary. appears prod never got the migration.
OpsOncall: change window in ~2h (13:00UTC). we can postpone promotion until after the window if needed.
Mira: options: 1) rollback prod to previous image (safe) 2) add a tolerant parser shim in next patch (fast but risky) 3) manually backfill prod SERVICE_CONFIG to structured JSON (operational risk).
Samir: also impacts model routing: inference runtime expects `cache.ttl` int. if parse fails we might hit uncached paths and spike token costs.
Devin: how urgent for customers? any traffic hitting feature flag?
Ashley: ~5 tenants on dedicated pools touched, but most use default path. could degrade latency.
OpsOncall: i'd vote rollback -> unblock. then backfill and schedule a hotfix in the change window.
Mira: agree. rollback gives us time to run a migration and add spec tests.
Samir: if we rollback, we should pin the model variant + config in the release note so deploybot doesn't auto-promote the new image again. add `model_pin: v2.13.7` to the release metadata.
Ashley: good call. i'll update release notes and add a manual hold.
Devin: for the backfill script: i can write a tiny idempotent patch that reads prod SERVICE_CONFIG, if string -> parse -> rewrite structured JSON. i'll add a dry-run to run in staging first.
Mira: please include unit test that asserts both string and object inputs map to same internal struct. prevents regression.
OpsOncall: does anyone object to rollback now?
Samir: no objections. +1
Devin: +1
Mira: +1
Ashley: rolling back (manual override). DeployBot: please mark release blocked until manual unpause. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Manual override received by Ashley. Rolling back release v2.14.0 to v2.13.7. Promotion halted.
DeployBot: NOTE: reason="SERVICE_CONFIG shape mismatch (string vs object)" metadata={"pin":"v2.13.7","blocked_by":"manual"}
Ashley: created PR with release note entry and pinned metadata: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/4321
Devin: will open PR for backfill + tests, target: change window.
Mira: update runbook: add a check that validates SERVICE_CONFIG parseability pre-promote.
Samir: once backfill and tests are green, we can unpin and promote. otherwise keep blocked.
OpsOncall: thanks team — i'll monitor logs for any post-rollback anomalies.
Ashley: closing thread after oncall verifies rollback success. keep updates in the release channel.
DeployBot: Rollback completed: v2.13.7 active in prod. Release v2.14.0 remains on hold.
